thread:
anya: Heads-up — competitor Nimbus launched per-route pricing today. Sales reports 3 pilots asking for 'route cost profiles'. Can we sketch a stopgap?

sam: Seen it. Full billing tie-in is heavy. Suggest a profiles-first approach: metadata + rules -> model_variant mapping. No billing rewrite initially.

maria: Pilots will accept phased delivery if we show clear tradeoffs. They specifically want a low-cost profile for background jobs.

felix: Technical risks: cache pollution if variants change, and unexpected tail latency. We should require model_variant-tagged cache keys for MVP.

lee: Minimal scope: route tagging API, small rule engine, console toggle, telemetry estimates. Billing reporting deferred.

deploy-bot: Note: reuse feature-flag infra for canary (5% tenants).

anya: Proposed plan: Sprint A: API + rules + flags (2 sprints). Sprint B: Console + telemetry + soft opt-outs (3 sprints). Sprint C: Billing reporting + quotas (Q2).

sam: I'll draft internal PRD and API contract. maria: please collect acceptance tests from pilots. felix: spike on cache regression. lee: console mockups.

maria: Will sync with Sales and share acceptance criteria by Fri.

anya: Ok — action owners set. Reunion next Wed to review artifacts.
